title: Essence textual syntax — class object specification
description: Each object describes one language construct (grammar non-terminal). Fields are suitable for code generation, documentation, or schema tooling.

constructs.name: PatternElement
constructs.syntaxRule: Alpha | AlphaAssociation | AlphaContainment | WorkProduct | WorkProductManifest | Activity | ActivitySpace | ActivityAssociation | Competency | Pattern | WorkBreakdown | Complexity | PrerequisiteAndAssumption | TeamRole;

constructs.name: AnyElement
constructs.syntaxRule: GroupElement | PracticeElement | State | Level | CheckListItem | CompetencyLevel | PatternAssociation | Tag | Resource;

constructs.name: KernelElement
constructs.syntaxRule: Alpha | AlphaAssociation | AlphaContainment | ActivitySpace | Competency | Kernel | ExtensionElement | MergeResolution | UserDefinedType;

constructs.name: Kernel
constructs.syntaxRule: 'kernel' ID ':' STRING ('with rules' STRING)? ('owns' '{' KernelElement* '}')? ('uses' '{' KernelElementRef (',' KernelElementRef)* '}')? (AddedTags)?;

constructs.name: Practice
constructs.syntaxRule: 'practice' ID ':' STRING 'with objective' STRING ('with measures' STRING(',' STRING)*)? ('with entry' STRING(',' STRING)*)? ('with result' STRING(',' STRING)*)? ('with rules' STRING)? ('owns' '{' PracticeElement* '}')? ('uses' '{' PracticeContentRef (',' PracticeContentRef)* '}')? (AddedTags)?;

constructs.name: Method
constructs.syntaxRule: 'method' ID 'based on' KernelRef ':' STRING 'with purpose' STRING ('owns' '{' MethodContent* '}')? ('uses' '{' PracticeRef(',' PracticeRef)* '}')? (AddedTags)?;

constructs.name: ActivitySpace
constructs.syntaxRule: 'activitySpace' ID ':' STRING (Resource(',' Resource)*)? 'targets' StateRef (',' StateRef)* ('with input' AlphaRef (',' AlphaRef)*)? (AddedTags)?;

constructs.name: Activity
constructs.syntaxRule: 'activity' ID ':' STRING (Resource(',' Resource)*)? 'targets' StateOrLevelRef (',' StateOrLevelRef)* ('with actions' Action (',' Action)*)? ('requires competency level' CompetencyLevelRef(',' CompetencyLevelRef)*)? (AddedTags)?;

constructs.name: WorkBreakdown
constructs.syntaxRule: 'workBreakdown' ID ':' STRING 'implements' ActivityRef 'using' PracticeRef ('in phase' STRING)? ('on track' STRING)? ('for product' STRING)? ('targets' StateOrLevelRef (',' StateOrLevelRef)*)? ('estimates' INT ',' INT ',' INT)? ('with complexity' ComplexityRef)? ('requires role' TeamRoleRef (',' TeamRoleRef)*)? (AddedTags)?;

constructs.name: Complexity
constructs.syntaxRule: 'complexity' ID ':' STRING ('with score' DECIMAL)? ('with impact type' STRING)? (AddedTags)?;

constructs.name: PrerequisiteAndAssumption
constructs.syntaxRule: 'prerequisiteAndAssumption' ID ':' STRING ('for phase' STRING)? ('for track' STRING)? ('for product' STRING)? ('for environment' STRING)? (AddedTags)?;

constructs.name: TeamRole
constructs.syntaxRule: 'teamRole' ID ':' STRING ('with labor category' STRING)? ('with primary skill' CompetencyLevelRef)? ('with secondary skills' CompetencyLevelRef (',' CompetencyLevelRef)*)? ('allocates billable time' INT)? (AddedTags)?;
